description:
Convert a score between formats and verify the result note by note,
or turn it into sheet music (pdf, png, svg) or audio (wav).

Returns a download link, a confidence level (exact, high, medium, low),
the share of notes kept, features the target format cannot hold, and
exporter quirks that were repaired on the way in.

content.description: The score itself as text (ABC, MusicXML, MEI or Humdrum)
content.title: Content

file.description: Link to the music file: from the Scoreproof upload page, or any public https URL
file.title: File

filename.description: Name for content, with its extension (default tune.abc)
filename.title: Filename

to.description: musicxml, mxl, midi, abc, mei, humdrum, or pdf/png/svg (sheet music) or wav (audio)
to.title: To

name: convert
title: Convert a music file
